caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an intricately designed metal oil lamp or vessel, centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is primarily brown with dark and rust-like shades, suggesting an aged metal. The base is a shallow, rounded bowl with three small protruding lips around its rim. Rising from the back of the bowl, the handle is flat and decorated with elaborate cut-out shapes and silhouettes resembling birds and leaves arranged vertically along its length. At the top of the handle is a twisted section, ending in a simple hook that curves outward. The overall composition is vertically oriented, and there are no additional objects or significant markings in the background.
title: Lamp
